evidence: Static code-path proof: DiagnosticLogFilterConfig and DiagnosticLogModuleFilter fields are public. A caller may safely construct minimum Minimum(Log) plus scope_prefix empty String and filter Off; the parser rejecting empty prefixes does not constrain handcrafted configs. settings.with_filter stores that config. Public level.rs filter_for_scope uses starts_with and selects empty prefix Off. CompiledDiagnosticLogFilter::new calls insert on empty bytes, assigning nodes[0].filter; compiled filter_for_scope returns minimum for one node and otherwise visits only child filters, never the root. DiagnosticLogState sink creation compiles the supplied config and sink write calls compiled.allows, so Log records pass and may enter the queue contrary to the public config query. Actual source labels only; no Rust execution is claimed.
impact: 手工配置空前缀 Off 且全局级别开启时，编译后的 sink 仍允许该级别日志进入队列，公开未编译查询却返回 Off。

next_action: 由产品 owner 统一公开配置与编译查询的空前缀契约，在最低过滤层验证根节点及与更长规则共存的情况；本审查不修复实现或更改 API。
